summary: Comprehensive testing of iter 216h104 features: Public Engineer Application form, Marketing header Engineers nav, and copy updates (30→10 referrals). All features verified working correctly.
seed_data_creation: Multiple TEST_ prefixed applications created during testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iter 216h104 features verified working. Public engineer application form at /partners/engineers/apply works without login. Backend POST /api/partners/public-apply is public and handles validation, file uploads, and idempotent resubmission correctly. GET /api/partners/applications requires master admin auth.

marketing_header_engineers_nav.details: Engineers nav item visible in header between Reporting and Pricing. Links to /partners/engineers. Also visible in mobile drawer via [data-testid=gx-nav-mobile-engineers].

public_engineer_application_form.details: Form at /partners/engineers/apply loads WITHOUT login redirect. Has 5 steps (About you, Service area, Skills & insurance, CV & supporting, Review & submit). Validation works for required fields (full_name, email). Invalid email shows error. CV upload tile present. Terms checkbox enables submit button. Success screen shows application_id.

backend_public_apply_endpoint.details: POST /api/partners/public-apply is PUBLIC (no auth required). Validates: missing full_name → 400/422, invalid email → 400, terms_accepted not true → 400. Valid payload returns {ok: true, application_id, status: 'pending'}. CV upload via multipart works. Idempotent resubmit with same email updates existing application (resubmitted=true). File >10MB returns 413. Unsupported extension (.exe) returns 400.

backend_applications_admin_endpoint.details: GET /api/partners/applications requires master admin auth (returns 401/403 without). Master admin can list all applications with {applications: [...], total: N}. Created applications appear in list. Attachments visible in admin view.

copy_updates_30_to_10.details: Partner Engineer landing /partners/engineers correctly mentions 'free at 10' and '10+ active gym referrals' for Founding tier. No incorrect '30 referrals' copy found. Marketing Home engineer banner also mentions 'free at 10 referrals'.

start_application_ctas.details: All 'Start application' CTAs now link to /partners/engineers/apply (public form). Verified on: Hero section, Final CTA section, Marketing Home engineer banner.
